name: Core Bus Gateway
description: Internal-only HTTP gateway that alone holds the event bus connection. Modules publish their declared events with a per-module key; the gateway stamps the source module and publishes through the eventbus-redis provider.

capabilities.description: POST /v1/publish on the internal network: per-module bearer key, manifest-declared topic allow-list (provides.events), source stamping, 202 only after the bus accepted the event.

keysFile.description: Path of the JSON key file {"<module-id>": "<key>"}. Keys are hashed in memory at startup.

manifests.description: Module manifest paths, separated by ':'. Each manifest's provides.events is that module's publish allow-list.

redisUrl.description: Credential-free Redis URL passed to the eventbus-redis provider.

redisPasswordFile.description: Path of the Core Redis password file (mode 0600 or 0400, not a symlink). Passed to the eventbus-redis provider as passwordFile; the gateway never reads or logs the value. Unset for a Redis without a password.

redisUsername.description: Redis ACL user name; requires redisPasswordFile. Unset for the default user.
